meaning: Every board in this directory was sealed BEFORE the official inactive lists published. None of them is governed by an official game-day active/inactive source, and none may be described as post-inactives.
why_not: official_inactives is BLOCKED[NO_EGRESS] from this executor; nfl.com returns HTTP 000. Requested as OUT-007. If the authoritative bytes never arrive these boards stand as they are and nothing is substituted for the list.
